purpose: Descriptive behavior comparison of frozen production CPU policy against recorded draft outcomes; not a quality, causal or historical-information validation.

definitions.tv: Total variation = one half the sum of absolute position-share differences; 0 equal, 1 disjoint. Per-round pooled counts compare average policy shares; individual-run TV also includes sampling noise.
definitions.effectivePositions: exp(Shannon entropy of position shares), per franchise; 1 means single-position class, larger means more diverse. Does not estimate need or quality.
definitions.tradeBaseline: Distinct transactions inside inclusive local draft date windows. Current-year-picks-only excludes player/future-pick assets, matching supported CPU assets more closely. Date-only windows can include off-clock transactions.
definitions.monteCarloSe: Between-seed sample SD / sqrt(12); simulation sampling error only. Not model uncertainty or independent historic sample uncertainty.

limitations: 12 fixed seeds and 12 rotating designated user franchises per class; auto-completion uses CPU picking for user picks but CPU trades exclude designated user franchise.
No human trades or board decisions; historical all-draftee and playable-only distributions differ because 19–83 actual draftees are reference-only.
Round shares and franchise statistics are descriptive, not a target to tune blindly toward; actual team needs, player quality and opportunity costs are not reconstructed.

Observed trade data need not be exhaustive; source extends only through 2026-04-17, making the 2026 draft trade comparator unavailable. Current-year-only scope misses genuine future-pick/player deals.
No policy tuning, calibration claim, significance test or player-to-wins quality inference is made.
